[PREFERENCE] User is focusing on building endurance to swim 750 meters without stopping.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant recommended breaking the 750 meters into smaller segments to build endurance gradually.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant suggested incorporating interval training to improve swimming speed and efficiency.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant recommended allocating 10-15 minutes for transition practice during brick workouts.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant provided specific drills to practice transitions efficiently, including T1 and T2 transition practices.  
[PREFERENCE] User aims to complete the bike and run segments of brick workouts at a comfortable pace rather than a specific pace or heart rate zone.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant recommended strength training exercises to improve overall endurance and reduce the risk of injury, including squats, lunges, deadlifts, leg press, calf raises, core exercises, and glute bridges.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant advised starting with lighter weights and progressively increasing the weight as strength builds.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant suggested incorporating functional exercises that mimic triathlon movements and targeting weaknesses in strength training.  
[ASSISTANT] The assistant emphasized the importance of warming up before strength training and cooling down afterward to prevent injury.
